messages:
alex: Heads up — I opened a plan for a combined TGW peering + IAM cleanup apply tied to release v2.3.1. Targeting change window today 18:00 PST. Will post plan summary and exact apply command. tagging @eng-infra and @oncall.

terraform-bot: terraform plan uploaded: https://ci.redwood.internal/terraform/plans/1764123456 — workspace infra-prod. Summary: +2 aws_iam_policy, ~3 aws_iam_role (inline policy updates), modify aws_route_table (add TGW routes), no EC2 instance replacements. Plan size: 18 resources to add/update.

maria: Quick Q — does that include the svc/redwood-api role rename we discussed? That one needs a two-step migration for dedicated accounts.

alex: Yes — plan includes the role rename but applied as rename (resource re-create) with lifecycle.prevent_destroy=false to allow rotation. I added a migration note in the plan output. For dedicated customers we'll pin module to previous module version and skip that resource.

sam: Please confirm module pinning detail. We can't roll out role rename for customers on Dedicated without a migration window.

alex: For dedicated tenant groups (tag:dedicated=true) we will run a targeted apply that excludes module.social_role via `-target` and then create an RFC to do the rename during the dedicated migration window next week. For hosted infra we'll do the full apply.

jen: Can you paste the relevant plan diff snippet for the IAM change? I'd like to review before approvals.

terraform-bot: ```
# aws_iam_role.svc_redwood_api must be replaced
- resource "aws_iam_role" "svc_redwood_api" {
    name = "svc-redwood-api-v1"
  }
+ resource "aws_iam_role" "svc_redwood_api" {
    name = "svc-redwood-api"
  }
```

irene: Noted. Also check policies attached to the role — one policy (svc-access-logs) has `s3:*` action in prod; we should scope it down in the same rollout to avoid audit noise.

alex: Good catch. Updated plan shows policy change from `s3:*` to `s3:GetObject,ListBucket` in the new policy resource. That change is additive (policy document update) and won't break attachments.

sam: Approving for hosted apply. :thumbsup:

jen: Approving for infra-prod hosted subset. For dedicated tenants I abstain until we coordinate the migration.

maria: Approving for dedicated-excluded plan once `-target` lines are added.

alex: Plan notes: - locking provider versions to `hashicorp/aws 4.60.0` and modules to `v1.9.2` for the dedicated run. - terraform state backup created: s3://tfstate-backups/infra-prod/backup-1764123456.tfstate.gz

alex: Apply steps I'll run at 18:00 PST: 1) `terraform apply -var-file=prod.tfvars -auto-approve` (hosted) 2) run smoke tests: `scripts/smoke/check-tgw.sh` + `scripts/smoke/iam-checks.sh` 3) monitor metrics for 30m (TGW route propagation + auth errors)

irene: Add an immediate rollback bullet: If we see >0.5% 5xxs from auth service in first 10m, revert by applying the previous state: `terraform state pull > state.json && aws s3 cp s3://tfstate-backups/infra-prod/backup-1764123456.tfstate.gz ./ && terraform apply -state=backup-1764123456.tfstate` — and open #incidents and tag @eng-oncall.

alex: Yes — rollback procedure documented in runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/terraform-apply-rollback. I'll post diffs in #incidents if we hit the threshold.

terraform-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled apply at 2026-03-20T18:00:00-08:00 (1764124800). Execute only after explicit :white_check_mark: from release lead.

alex: Release lead (maria) — we need your final green to proceed.

maria: Green for hosted apply at 18:00. I'll wait 10m post-apply to sign off and then release tag v2.3.1 will be pushed.

sam: I'll be on standby for the first 30m to watch endpoints. ping me in thread if anything looks off.

jen: Leaving a note — please ensure we don't run the dedicated exclude apply in the same window. That one goes next Tuesday.

alex: Understood. I'll run hosted apply only, then post the apply output here. If any manual steps required I'll escalate immediately.

maria: Thanks everyone. :rocket:
